news.title: President Danko Named to Indiana 250 for Fifth Consecutive Year
news.summary_en: Butler University President James Danko has once again been recognized among Indiana’s most influential leaders, earning a place on the Indianapolis Business Journal’s 2026 Indiana 250. The honor marks Danko’s fifth consecutive appearance on the annual list, making him one of just 84 leaders statewide who have been recognized every year since the Indiana 250…
news.author: Katie Palmer Wharton '14
